# MEMRYA

> MEMRYA is an iPhone-first AI connected-memory product. Users record or import conversations, which become source evidence in an evolving memory of people, decisions, commitments, tasks, open loops and grounded answers.

## Product

- Core flow: record/import -> transcription and analysis -> connected memory -> Memory search and follow-up actions -> export/share.
- Conversations remain available as source evidence; the long-term product surface connects related people, decisions, tasks, commitments, reminders, open loops and ongoing threads across conversations.
- Existing audio import is a core use case.
- Speaker diarization and contextual/name speaker identity are part of the conversation-processing flow.
- Memory search retrieves across relevant conversations while preserving links back to source evidence. Long-history cross-conversation recall is still being validated.
- Quick Memory lets users add something worth remembering without needing a full recorded conversation.

## Languages

- Public UI languages: English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian. Arabic renders true RTL.
- Spoken Language and Result Language are separate settings; Result Language defaults to the language of the conversation.
- Spoken-language detection and transcription depend on the configured processing provider. This website is available in seven languages. Processing availability and quality vary by language and recording; check the app for current options.

## Billing

- Recording on device is intended to remain free.
- Cloud processing consumes processing minutes.
- MEMRYA Pro launch catalog: US$19.90 per month including 900 processing minutes (15 hours). Extra minute packs: 300 min US$8.99, 600 min US$15.99, 1,800 min US$44.99, 5,400 min US$129.99. The App Store confirms final local price, currency and renewal terms before purchase.

## Availability

- Existing audio import: available.
- Zoom and Google Meet: users can import existing meeting recordings as supported audio files. Direct account connections are limited by availability; Zoom LIVE capture is not offered.
- Google Calendar: users can review a proposed calendar event draft and save it themselves; direct account authorization is restricted to a pilot pending Google permission verification. No two-way calendar sync.
- Microsoft Teams direct integration is not currently offered.
- PDF export and sharing: in testing on iPhone, not yet confirmed as generally available.
- Voice Identity: still being tested, not generally available; optional and consent-based when offered.
- MEMRYA for iPhone is not yet generally available in the App Store. There is no waitlist; questions can be sent to dev@memrya.co.

## Trust and privacy

- Provider and API secrets are server-side only, never embedded in the mobile client.
- Cloud storage is private, access is limited to the owning account, and each account's data is kept separate.
- Processed audio and transcripts may be sent securely to approved processing providers after the user chooses processing.
- MEMRYA does not claim end-to-end encryption.
- Account export and deletion requests can be made through the Delete account page or dev@memrya.co.

## Website

- Domain: https://memrya.co
- No analytics, cookies, third-party JavaScript, trackers or public API keys. Strict CSP.
